fieldNotes.truckGate: Plant set back from 200 West behind grass buffers; access road off 200 West into the yard. No barrier/booth visible from Street View - controlled gate inferred at low-medium confidence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible from public-road Street View. Marked false / remoteGs true at low-medium confidence.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail spur runs along the west side of the plant; rail cars/tankers visible in the north yard.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Trailer drop yard and dock apron along the south face of the bakery building; ~25 trailers visible.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Dock banks along the south building face; ~35 estimate banded 25-50, low confidence.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single large bakery building (N-S) with attached process structures; not a multi-cluster campus.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from perimeter box ~755m N-S x ~370m E-W.
fieldNotes.locationResolution: Roster coordinates (RANGE_INTERPOLATED) landed in central/south Richmond; web search located plant at 901 N 200 W. Confirmed by satellite ~41.9388,-111.8165.
